titulo: Baseboard Heat vs Heat Pump: Minnesota Bill #shorts
descripcion: Yearly heating cost of a typical cold-climate home in Minnesota: electric baseboard $2,342 vs heat pump $1,065 (federal minimum, HSPF2 7.5 ≈ 2.2 units of heat per unit of electricity). Heating needs: EIA RECS 2020; electricity: EIA, MN 16.44¢/kWh (Jan–Aug 2026). Running costs only.
